purpose: Multiple opponents retain coherent mission focus; diplomacy/defeat cleanly retargets without ignoring local threats

acceptance.requiredOutcome: Multiple opponents retain coherent mission focus; diplomacy/defeat cleanly retargets without ignoring local threats
setup: Three or more ordinary supported players have real diplomacy and defeat state
AI has a coherent offensive focus and a distinct local defensive threat
actions: Defeat or change relation of the focused opponent through the authoritative game path
Keep another legal opponent and local threat present
measurements: Player relations, actual defeat result, target ownership and squad/objective continuity
Native retarget and local defense effects
required: Invalid former enemy focus releases cleanly and remaining opponents receive coherent useful focus
forbidden: Switching whole army between every opponent each tick
acceptance.checkpointPolicy: These are planned sampling ticks, not observed evidence. At binding add exact native event-boundary samples without changing the original outer ceiling; per-event capture is required where polling would miss a transient.

capabilityLimits: Current relation authority uses player-definition teams; there is no in-match diplomacy command. Initial allied-team control is bound; dynamic diplomacy transition remains unsupported, not passed. Native defeat/retargeting uses the real three-spawn AI Multiplayer map.
